component.name: hwcloud-imagerecognition
component.title: Huawei Cloud Image Recognition
component.description: Recognize celebrities and tag the objects, scenes and concepts in images with Huawei Cloud Image Recognition.
component.label: cloud,messaging

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

producerIn.description: Not used, not even for the image: the image comes from the imageContent option or the CamelHwCloudImageContent exchange property as base64, or from the imageUrl option or the CamelHwCloudImageUrl exchange property as a URL

producerOut.description: The result of the Huawei Cloud SDK: for celebrityRecognition a List with a CelebrityRecognitionResultBody per celebrity found, and for tagRecognition an ImageTaggingResponseResult with the tags

operation.label: producer
operation.description: The operation that the producer performs: celebrityRecognition to recognize the celebrities in the image, or tagRecognition to return tags for the objects, scenes and concepts in the image.

accessKey.description: The access key ID (AK) of the Huawei Cloud account, which signs the requests to Image Recognition. If not set, the accessKey of the serviceKeys option is used.

endpoint.description: The URL of Image Recognition, for example https://image.cn-north-4.myhuaweicloud.com. If set, the region option is not used.

imageContent.description: The image as a Base64 string, in JPG, PNG or BMP format and at most 10 MB. The CamelHwCloudImageContent exchange property replaces this option. Set this option or imageUrl; if both are set, the producer sends both to Image Recognition.

imageUrl.description: The URL of the image: a public HTTP or HTTPS URL, or the URL of an object in Object Storage Service (OBS) that Image Recognition is authorized to read. The CamelHwCloudImageUrl exchange property replaces this option. Set this option or imageContent; if both are set, the producer sends both to Image Recognition.

projectId.description: The ID of the Huawei Cloud project that the requests to Image Recognition are made in.

proxyHost.description: The host name or IP address of the proxy server for the requests to Image Recognition. If not set, no proxy is used.

proxyPassword.description: The password for the authentication with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyUser options are set.

proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost option is set.

proxyUser.description: The user name for the authentication with the proxy server. It is used only when the proxyHost option is set.

region.description: The region ID of Image Recognition, for example cn-north-4. If the endpoint option is not set, the producer looks up the endpoint of this region in the Huawei Cloud SDK, and fails for a region that the SDK does not know.

secretKey.description: The secret access key (SK) of the Huawei Cloud account, which signs the requests to Image Recognition. If not set, the secretKey of the serviceKeys option is used.

serviceKeys.description: The access key and secret key as an org.apache.camel.component.huaweicloud.common.models.ServiceKeys. Its accessKey and its secretKey are each used when the option of the same name is not set.

tagLanguage.description: The language of the tags that tagRecognition returns: zh for Chinese or en for English. The CamelHwCloudImageTagLanguage exchange property replaces this option. The producer rejects any other value.

tagLimit.description: The maximum number of tags that tagRecognition returns. The CamelHwCloudImageTagLimit exchange property replaces this option.

threshold.description: The minimum confidence score of a returned result: from 0 to 100 for tagRecognition (60 if not set), and from 0 to 1 for celebrityRecognition (0.48 if not set). The CamelHwCloudImageThreshold exchange property replaces this option. The producer rejects a value outside the range of the operation.

ignoreSslVerification.label: security
ignoreSslVerification.description: Whether to skip the verification of the TLS certificate of Image Recognition. This is unsafe, and meant for testing only.
